newsitem.title: ITALY: Embraco boosts Italian compressor output.
newsitem.headline: Embraco boosts Italian compressor output.

text.p: Embraco Europe, part of Brazil's Brasmotor SA group, has invested $30 million to boost the production of refrigerator compressors by its Italian subsidiary Embraco Aspera.

The production of a new-generation compressor is aimed at consolidating Embraco's presence in Europe where it has around a 24 percent market share, Embraco Europe's managing director Ricardo Andres Domicent told a news conference.
Embraco was also looking at potential markets in North Africa and the Middle East, he said.
Brasmotor is Latin America's largest white-goods producer.
By 2001, Embraco wants to invest a further $65 million to modernise its own plants.

With the new line inaugurated on Thursday, the plant at Riva di Chieri, Turin, will raise production to around six million compressors this year, from 5.2 million in 1995, and will rise to seven million next year, the company said.
The group's Italian subsidiary expects 1996 turnover of around 450 billion lire.

The Embraco group, one of the major world producers of compressors for refrigerators with a global market share of 18 percent, has some 10,000 employees, net sales worth $727 million and a net profit of $59 million.
The group aimed to increase its global market share to 23 percent by the end of the century, Domicent said.

Other than plants in Brazil and Italy, where it purchased Aspera from Whirlpool Corp Corp, Embraco is also present in China where it set up a joint venture last year togther with Whirlpool and a Chinese partner.
